parameters.query:
UPDATE bookings.memberships
SET
  status     = $1,
  updated_at = NOW()
WHERE id = $2::uuid
  AND tenant_id = $3
RETURNING id AS membership_id, status, customer_id, updated_at::text;

INSERT INTO bookings.customer_interactions
  (customer_id, customer_name, customer_email, customer_phone,
   booking_id, booking_date, room_name,
   subject, interaction_type, notes, timestamp, staff_member, tenant_id)
VALUES
  ($1::uuid, $2, $3, '',
   NULL, NULL, NULL,
   'Membership status changed to: ' || $4,
   'membership',
   'Membership ID: ' || $5 || ' — status set to ' || $4,
   NOW(), $6, $7)
RETURNING id;

options.queryReplacement:
={{ [
  $('DB: Update Status').first().json.customer_id || '',
  $('Webhook: Update Membership Status').first().json.body?.customer_name || '',
  $('Webhook: Update Membership Status').first().json.body?.customer_email || '',
  $('DB: Update Status').first().json.status || '',
  $('DB: Update Status').first().json.membership_id || '',
  $('Webhook: Update Membership Status').first().json.body?.performed_by || 'Staff',
  parseInt($('Webhook: Update Membership Status').first().json.body?.tenant_id || '0')
